summary: The enhanced prompt effectively translates the original instruction into a detailed, actionable, and visually coherent cinematic plan. It preserves all core elements — sci-fi exotic wonder, documentary realism, classical painting aesthetic, continuous camera movement, and environmental audio — while adding precise shot specifications, character dialogue, and visual timing.
